```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`DSEMr` supports binary and ordinal outcomes and dynamic IRT indicators via
Albert-Chib latent-response probit data augmentation (threshold parameterization
`u$1 = -nu`), as well as continuous floor-, ceiling-, and interval-censored
outcomes via Bayesian Tobit data augmentation.

## Binary probit AR(1)

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

dat_bin <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 100, intercept = 0.2, ar = 0.45, sigma = 1,
  family = "binary", seed = 627
)
m_bin <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", family = "binary", time = "time")
fit_bin <- dsem(m_bin, dat_bin, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 627)
coef(fit_bin)
```

## Tobit floor-censored AR(1)

Many intensive longitudinal measures (e.g., negative affect, pain, or craving)
exhibit substantial floor effects at zero. Declaring `censored = list(y = c(0, Inf))`
(or `CENSORED = y (b);`) activates exact truncated-normal Gibbs augmentation:

```{r}
dat_cens <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 120, intercept = 0.2, ar = 0.5, sigma = 0.7,
  censored = c(0, Inf), seed = 701
)
m_cens <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time", censored = list(y = c(0, Inf)))
fit_cens <- dsem(m_cens, dat_cens, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 702)
coef(fit_cens)
dsem_dic(fit_cens)
```

Dynamic binary IRT with fixed factor innovation variance (`f@1`) and free item
loadings compiles directly from either `lavaan` syntax (`categorical = c("u1", "u2", "u3", "u4")`)
or section-based script syntax (`VARIABLE: CATEGORICAL = u1-u4;`).
